package categorize

// Generator of the dev-health-go llm OpenAI Batch oracle (CHAOS-8719). Run
// once in a throwaway worktree; never committed to ops. It records, for ops'
// own frozen-Python batch corpus (batch_frozen_python_test.go): the frozen
// Python answer (testdata/golden/batch.golden.json), the ops Go port's answer
// (batchLine, parseOpenAIBatchLines, mapOpenAIBatchStatus), and the request
// inputs each line was built from.

import (
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

type batchOracleLineInput struct {
	Name            string          `json:"name"`
	Model           string          `json:"model"`
	ConfigFloor     int             `json:"config_max_output_tokens"`
	CustomID        string          `json:"custom_id"`
	System          string          `json:"system"`
	Prompt          string          `json:"prompt"`
	FormatName      string          `json:"format_name"`
	Schema          json.RawMessage `json:"schema"`
	RequestFloor    int             `json:"request_max_output_tokens"`
	OpsLine         string          `json:"ops_line"`
	PythonLine      json.RawMessage `json:"python_line"`
	NamedDivergence bool            `json:"named_divergence"`
}

type batchOracleParse struct {
	Name            string          `json:"name"`
	Text            string          `json:"text"`
	OpsError        bool            `json:"ops_error"`
	OpsResults      json.RawMessage `json:"ops_results"`
	PythonError     bool            `json:"python_error"`
	PythonResults   json.RawMessage `json:"python_results"`
	NamedDivergence bool            `json:"named_divergence"`
}

func TestZZGenerateLLMBatchOracle(t *testing.T) {
	out := os.Getenv("LLM_BATCH_ORACLE_OUT")
	if out == "" {
		t.Skip("set LLM_BATCH_ORACLE_OUT")
	}
	corpus := batchOracleCorpus()
	// Read the frozen answer straight from the golden: the recording
	// framework binds a golden to the one test that recorded it.
	goldenRaw, err := os.ReadFile("testdata/golden/batch.golden.json")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if got := fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha256.Sum256(goldenRaw)); got != batchGoldenPins["batch.golden.json"] {
		t.Fatalf("golden digest %s is not ops' pinned %s", got, batchGoldenPins["batch.golden.json"])
	}
	var recording struct {
		Requests []struct {
			Name string `json:"name"`
			Body string `json:"body"`
		} `json:"requests"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(goldenRaw, &recording); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var answer batchOracleAnswer
	for _, request := range recording.Requests {
		if request.Name == "batch provider oracle" {
			decoder := json.NewDecoder(strings.NewReader(request.Body))
			decoder.UseNumber()
			if err := decoder.Decode(&answer); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
		}
	}
	if len(answer.Lines) == 0 {
		t.Fatal("no frozen answer in the golden")
	}
	var lines []batchOracleLineInput
	for _, lc := range corpus.Lines {
		var request CompletionRequest
		switch lc.Kind {
		case "categorization":
			request = CategorizationRequest(BuildPrompt(lc.SourceBlock))
		case "explanation":
			request = InvestmentMixExplanationRequest(lc.Prompt)
		case "plain":
			request = WorkUnitExplanationRequest(lc.Prompt)
		}
		line, err := goBatchLine(lc)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		schema := json.RawMessage("null")
		name := ""
		if request.JSONSchema != nil {
			schema, _ = json.Marshal(request.JSONSchema)
			name = request.ResponseFormatName
		}
		lines = append(lines, batchOracleLineInput{
			Name: lc.Name, Model: lc.Model, ConfigFloor: lc.MaxOutputTokens, CustomID: lc.CustomID,
			System: request.SystemMessage, Prompt: request.Prompt, FormatName: name, Schema: schema,
			RequestFloor: request.MaxOutputTokens, OpsLine: string(line), PythonLine: answer.Lines[lc.Name].Line,
			NamedDivergence: batchDivergences["lines/"+lc.Name],
		})
	}
	var parses []batchOracleParse
	for _, pc := range corpus.Parse {
		results, err := parseOpenAIBatchLines([]byte(pc.Text))
		entry := batchOracleParse{Name: pc.Name, Text: pc.Text, OpsError: err != nil,
			PythonError: answer.Parse[pc.Name].Error, PythonResults: answer.Parse[pc.Name].Results,
			NamedDivergence: batchDivergences["parse/"+pc.Name]}
		if err == nil {
			encoded, _ := json.Marshal(results)
			entry.OpsResults = encoded
		} else {
			entry.OpsResults = json.RawMessage("null")
		}
		parses = append(parses, entry)
	}
	statuses := map[string]map[string]string{}
	for _, status := range corpus.Statuses {
		statuses[status] = map[string]string{"ops": string(mapOpenAIBatchStatus(status)), "python": answer.Statuses[status]}
	}
	encoded, err := json.MarshalIndent(map[string]any{
		"header": map[string]any{
			"producer":             "dev-health-ops internal/jobs/investment/categorize: the ops Go port (batchLine, parseOpenAIBatchLines, mapOpenAIBatchStatus) and the frozen Python answer it is pinned to",
			"ops_sha":              os.Getenv("LLM_ORACLE_OPS_SHA"),
			"python_build":         batchPythonBuild,
			"python_golden":        "internal/jobs/investment/categorize/testdata/golden/batch.golden.json",
			"python_golden_sha256": fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha256.Sum256(goldenRaw)),
			"named_divergences":    strings.Join(sortedNames(batchDivergences), ","),
		},
		"lines":         lines,
		"parse":         parses,
		"statuses":      statuses,
		"result_fields": answer.ResultFields,
		"metadata_keys": answer.MetadataKeys,
	}, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(out, append(encoded, '\n'), 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
